## Diagram Features

### Component Branches

- **Hierarchical Trees:** Shows parent-child relationships between components
- **Data Flow:** Arrows show how data flows through component branches
- **Branch Labels:** Relationship types labeled on connections

### Integration Points

- **Component-to-System:** Shows which components handle external integrations
- **Port Connections:** Integration ports mapped to handling components
- **System-to-System:** External system connections with port labels

### Styling

- **Layer Colors:** Distinct colors for each of 6 layers
- **Component Colors:** Styled by component kind (core, storage, pipeline, etc.)
- **Connection Styles:** Different line styles for different relationship types
